title: Post-Event-Read currentness over the complete basis
method: the attributed Preview captures chosen.relevantBasis at qualification time and recomputes it after readEvents(); relevantBasisDifference() reports the first semantic difference
observed: a new Invocation, a changed selected-invocation history, or a competing creator claim yields RACED; a duplicate identical observation and an unrelated project append do NOT
expectedInvariant: a detected change to the basis supporting admission cannot silently produce stale SELECTED_UNIQUE or stale Session ownership
remainingUncertainty: this is a bounded optimistic read-check, not a distributed transaction; it does not loop and does not retry indefinitely
